gloss: closing time (of a shop or restaurant)

definitions.gloss: closing time; the time at which a shop, restaurant, or other business closes for the day
definitions.explanation: The time at which a retail shop, restaurant, or similar business stops operating for the day. Posted on shop signs and websites, and commonly discussed when planning visits.

examples.japanese: {閉店時間|へいてんじかん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何時|なんじ}→何時：00973_nanji⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
{閉店時間|へいてんじかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{近|ちか}づいた→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{急|いそ}いで→急ぐ：01191_isogu⟧⟦{会計|かいけい}→会計：02536_kaikei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{済|す}ませた→済む：01950_sumu⟧。
examples.english: Closing time was approaching, so I hurried to pay the bill.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{平日|へいじつ}→平日：03033_heijitsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{閉店時間|へいてんじかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please note that this restaurant's closing time is different on weekdays and weekends.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{閉店|へいてん}→閉店：09698_heiten⟧ (closing of a shop) and ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ (time). Used for the closing time of retail establishments — shops, restaurants, cafes, banks, and similar businesses that have daily opening and closing hours.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {閉店時間|へいてんじかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{近|ちか}づく→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧: closing time approaches
- {閉店時間|へいてんじかん}⟦{間際|まぎわ}→間際：14564_magiwa⟧: right before closing time
- {閉店時間|へいてんじかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧: to go past closing time
- {閉店時間|へいてんじかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{延長|えんちょう}→延長：06447_enchou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to extend closing time
- {閉店時間|へいてんじかん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧9⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧: the closing time is 9 PM

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {開店時間|かいてんじかん}: opening time — the antonym
- ⟦{営業時間|えいぎょうじかん}→営業時間：18476_eigyoujikan⟧: business hours — covers the whole range from opening to closing
- ⟦{閉館|へいかん}→閉館：18858_heikan⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: closing time of a museum, library, or other public facility (not a shop)
- ⟦{終業|しゅうぎょう}→終業：18204_shuugyou⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: end-of-work time — for offices/workplaces, not for shops serving customers
